plain: To subtract; to take an amount away.

webster.text: To take from; to subtract; to separate or remove, in numbering, estimating or calculating.

example.quote: Lot him deduct these bounties, and he will find the amount actually paid to be extremely small.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, New York Convention, June 27, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
